summary: Grants the API's service role access to portal_user_residencies (created in 186 without grants), so the renter portal path stops failing with 'permission denied'. Privileges only: no schema or row changes.

preflight.name: portal_user_residencies exists
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'portal_user_residencies'

expected_changes: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on portal_user_residencies to service_role.
No rows added, changed or deleted; no schema change.

verify.name: service_role can read portal_user_residencies
verify.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN has_table_privilege('service_role', 'portal_user_residencies', 'SELECT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

verify.name: service_role can write portal_user_residencies
verify.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN has_table_privilege('service_role', 'portal_user_residencies', 'INSERT') AND has_table_privilege('service_role', 'portal_user_residencies', 'UPDATE') AND has_table_privilege('service_role', 'portal_user_residencies', 'DELETE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
